description: The OIDC web applications staff sign in through (root ADR-0116). configure-zitadel.sh ensures each one in the project; the list lives here and only here. The host of every https redirect URI is also made a trusted domain of the instance: that console relays Zitadel's sign-in pages on its own origin (root ADR-0434 §2).

applications.name: dawneer
applications.dev_mode_reason: The console is served from the data host at its https origin behind Cloudflare Access (root ADR-0434); the laptop loopback origin of root ADR-0116 §5 is retired with it.

applications.name: datahub
applications.dev_mode_reason: The trial catalog is reached from a staff laptop over an SSH tunnel on the loopback; a public https origin turns this off.

applications.name: airflow
applications.dev_mode_reason: The scheduler UI is reached from a staff laptop over an SSH tunnel on the loopback (root ADR-0122); a public https origin turns this off.
